brand_identity.name: BetoDecor
brand_identity.tone: Professional, reliable, qualitative, experienced, high-end construction.
anti_patterns: No electric blue or '24/7 emergency' aesthetic
No over-the-top countdowns or fake reviews

headings.scale: text-4xl to text-6xl for hero, tight tracking.
headings.description: Architectural, bold, authoritative. Used for marketing headlines and major section titles.

body.scale: text-base for reading, text-sm for dashboard data.
body.description: Clean, highly legible, professional. Perfect for multi-step wizards, data tables, and CRM dashboards.

layouts.marketing_homepage: Bento Grid Protocol. Generous spacing (p-16 to p-24). Asymmetric arrangements. Avoid generic centered text. Use overlapping images and strong left-aligned typography.
layouts.intake_wizard: Centralized card layout (max-w-3xl) with a visible step progress bar ('Stap X van 7'). Clear typography, plenty of padding (p-8).
layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density Grid Protocol. Sidebar navigation. KPI summary cards (col-span-1) at the top. Full-width data tables below. Use cardless or 1px border cards.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient and soft: `shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]` for marketing cards.
visual_enhancers.radius: `rounded-xl` for cards and images, `rounded-full` for primary marketing CTAs to add approachability.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use Framer Motion for wizard step transitions (slide in/out horizontally). Hover lifts (`-translate-y-1`) for dashboard cards.

component_guidelines.buttons: Primary: `bg-[#9C5B3E] text-white hover:bg-[#7A452E] rounded-full`. Use `rounded-lg` for dashboard utilities.
component_guidelines.inputs_forms: Customized Shadcn inputs. `border-stone-300`, `focus:ring-[#9C5B3E]`, `focus:border-transparent`. Ensure large touch targets for mobile.
component_guidelines.data_table: Shadcn Table. Clean rows with `hover:bg-stone-50`. Incorporate the custom score badges in the 'Score' column.
component_guidelines.wizard_progress: A clear visual progress track (e.g., segmented line) with text 'Stap X van 7'. Must support back navigation without data loss.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not required for this project. High-quality real photography builds more trust for physical renovation. Keep the focus on 2D crisp layouts and high-res images.

instructions_to_main_agent: Discard the old 'Sanivolt' electric blue (#0038FF) and emergency plumber styling. Use the new 'BetoDecor' premium warm color palette.
Build a multilingual header (NL/FR/EN/ES dropdown) ensuring BetoDecor serves the Brussels region.
Implement the marketing homepage with the provided copy ('BetoDecor — Totaalrenovatie & Bouw...') and primary CTA 'Vraag een renovatieofferte aan'.
Create the 7-step intake wizard: (1) Type project, (2) Omvang, (3) Welke werken, (4) Budget, (5) Planning, (6) Locatie, (7) Foto's/plannen + contact.
Ensure the wizard maintains state so users can navigate back. Include a 'Stap X van 7' visual indicator and photo/PDF upload with previews.
Strict commercial rule: Never suggest an automatic definitive price to the user. Always frame the output as 'Renovatieaanvraag' or 'Projectbeoordeling'.
Build a secure Admin Login page.
Build the CRM Dashboard for 'Roberto': Include KPI cards (New/HOT/HIGH/NORMAL/LOW leads, total value, avg budget, location stats).
Implement the lead table sorted by Lead Score (0-100) using the specified color badges. Lead statuses: Nieuw / Bezocht / Offerte verzonden.
Implement the Lead Detail page: Show project info, media gallery, contact actions (Bellen/E-mail/WhatsApp/Plaatsbezoek plannen) and status toggles.
Use Lucide-react for all icons, favoring thin, professional strokes.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use glass-morphism selectively (e.g., sticky header: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-stone-200`).
Create depth through layered design elements and generous spacing (2-3x standard padding).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to match the BetoDecor premium architectural brand.
Ensure text contrast ratios meet APCA/WCAG standards.
